messages:
anna: Kicking off scheduled profile-schema migration in 5m (2.4.1 -> 2.5.0). Change window 23:05-23:20 UTC. Read-only quiesce begins at 23:00. Deploybot will drive steps. Release notes: https://go/releases/3672

deploybot: PRECHECK OK — canary queued on shard-3. Holdpoint set: wait for CANARY_PASS before staging. Steps: 1) apply DDL, 2) async backfill (rate-limited), 3) concurrent index rebuild. To abort: `abort deploy`.

sam: ack. Who's watching the index build? I can take first 10m. What's hard rollback look like if backfill spikes?

mig-ops: Rollback plan: if backfill throughput >10x baseline or queue growth >5m for >2 windows, abort and revert to pinned snapshot (schema v2.4.1). Read-only fallback via replica routing until rollback completes. Manual flip required for feature flag `use_new_profile_schema`.

liyah: Can we pin runtime/service version to avoid accidental client-side schema mismatch? Request pin to runtime v2026-03-18-prod for this window.

anna: Pin applied in release config: runtime_version=v2026-03-18-prod and migration flag gated behind canary. Also added short blurb to release notes about TTL on backfill rows.

deploybot: CANARY COMPLETE on shard-3 — no schema errors, no queries failing, p50 latency unchanged. Proceeding to staged rollout to shards 1-2 in 2m.

sam: Observed a 4s replica lag spike during index create on shard-3, within threshold. continuing watch. I have dashboard panels open: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd

mig-ops: Additional abort criteria: sustained error rate >0.5% for requests touching `profile` table across 3 consecutive 1m bins, or any unexpected deadlocks during backfill. If triggered: set `use_new_profile_schema=false`, run deploybot `abort run 1718888888`, and coordinate snapshot restore with DB team.

anna: If we need an immediate rollback, please call out in-thread and run the abort command. After abort we will tag ops for snapshot and prepare postmortem. Keep all notes in this thread.

deploybot: STAGED ROLLOUT started for shards 1-2. Estimated finish ~8m. Will post status updates.

liyah: Pushing final release_notes entry: "Profile schema migration 2.5.0 — adds membership_tier columns, backfills historical tiers at safe-rate, and builds concurrent index to support new queries. Monitors: profile read latency, replica lag, backfill queue depth." Link: https://go/releases/3672/details

sam: thumbs up. I'll escalate if any read latency > +15% or error spikes.

anna: Plan: sign-off at +20m if no regressions. Tagging @liam for PM notes and follow-up. Good luck everyone :rocket:
